Name: Mystery Caladium Crop Mod
Author: LittleEddo
Description:
[b]Mystery Caladiums - Tropical Surprise Crop Expansion[/b]
[heading]Description[/heading]
Bring the beauty of tropical foliage to Stardew Valley with [b]Mystery Caladiums[/b]!
This mod introduces a brand-new surprise crop: the [b]Mystery Caladium Bulb[/b]. Plant the bulb on your farm and wait for it to grow into a beautiful caladium variety. Each bulb contains a hidden possibility — you never know which unique color and pattern will bloom until the plant matures.
Discover different caladium varieties, collect rare foliage, and transform your farm into a tropical botanical paradise. Harvesting caladiums may also reward you with exclusive caladium-themed furniture decorations, allowing you to bring your favorite plants indoors.
More caladium varieties and decorative items will be added in future updates. Stay tuned!
[line]
Installation Instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API).[/*]
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder into:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Enjoy growing your mysterious caladiums![/*]
[/list][line]
Main Features
🌱 [b]Mystery Caladium Crop[/b]
[list]
[*]Grow a special caladium bulb crop with surprise outcomes.[/*]
[*]Each harvest brings the possibility of discovering different caladium varieties.[/*]
[/list]🍃 [b]Unique Tropical Plant Designs[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds colorful caladium foliage inspired by real-world ornamental plants.[/*]
[*]Designed with Stardew Valley pixel art style.[/*]
[/list]🎁 [b]Surprise Harvest Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*]Harvesting caladiums may provide decorative caladium furniture items.[/*]
[*]Create your own indoor tropical plant collection.[/*]
[/list]🏡 [b]Farm Decoration Expansion[/b]
[list]
[*]Add more botanical beauty and personality to your farmhouse and garden.[/*]
[/list]🌿 [b]Future Expansion Ready[/b]
[list]
[*]More varieties, furniture, and tropical plants are planned for future updates.[/*]
[/list][line]

This mod contains some AI-assisted visual elements. These assets were further edited, pixelated, and adapted manually to match Stardew Valley's visual style.AI was used as a creative assistance tool, while the final artistic direction and implementation were completed by the author.
